snippet.title: ColdBurn Trailer
snippet.description:
ColdBurn Neon-vector arcade shooter where momentum, weapon heat, and split-second decisions keep you alive. Master your drift, perfect your vents, and fight through 7 deadly systems alone or with a second pilot in local, online, or LAN co-op.
Now Available on Steam Early Access! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5365360/ColdBurn/
